chunks: And He is the Dominant over His servants, and sends over you guardians, until when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take his soul, and they do not falter.
ai.seo_question: Who takes the soul at the moment of death according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty (Al-Qahir) and the continuous presence of recording angels (Huffaz) who monitor human actions until the moment of death. It emphasizes the precision of the angels of death (Rusuluna) in extracting the soul, reflecting the divine attribute of justice where no detail is overlooked or delayed. This concept reinforces the belief in the meticulous accounting of deeds, a central theme in Shia eschatology.
